name: Sediles (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow with a blue triangle at the hoist, charged across the centre with a white feather bearing the bars of Aragon.
history: Municipal flag of Sediles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
feather across the centre bearing the red and yellow bars of Aragon
